setup: An optimized native host loaded disposable stock Zaton. A private socket harness sent two grounded player poses and recorded native NPC replicas and autonomous hits.

linuxArm64GraphicsSmoke.environment: Ubuntu 24.04 ARM64 container with SDL 2.30 and Mesa 25.2.8
linuxArm64GraphicsSmoke.scope: SDL window and graphics context creation. The first build exceeded the 2 GiB VM memory limit.

linuxArm64FirstEngineRun: The 8 GiB retry built and initialized SDL offscreen and the OpenAL null device. The engine allocator then returned a pointer outside LuaJIT’s 47-bit range and the VM failed to initialize.

flyX86_64.environment: Temporary private Frankfurt Fly.io Machine with Ubuntu 24.04, SDL offscreen and Mesa llvmpipe
flyX86_64.build: Optimized x86-64 native host with the initial synchronous world checkpoints
flyX86_64.restart: The first in-place restart rejected the checkpoint at the fence check. The subsequent isolated copy with a verified matching save and fence loaded in 1.445 seconds and reported 31.33 metres of mutant motion. The harness did not observe an autonomous hit during that restart.
flyX86_64.cleanup: The temporary Machine and app were destroyed after copying the verified artifact.
